answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. The key insight is that coordination itself leaks: the more unified a farm is, the more easily its shared style or timing betrays it. This is why the honest majority can be small yet decisive: each vote carries the weight of verifiable work, not just the noise of a large flock. Consider a comet as the anchor of the cost.
